correctness.rationale: The complex is precisely specified by twelve cube edges and induced maximum selected degree at most one. All 4095 nonempty masks were tested, giving 455 faces, dimension four and exact f-vector. A deterministic 211-pair discrete-Morse matching has exactly one critical zero-cell and 32 critical 3-faces; topological sort of the entire oriented Hasse graph visits every face and proves acyclicity. Forman Morse reduction therefore gives an integral homotopy wedge of 32 three-spheres. A geometrically independent coordinate representation independently reproduces the face vector, Euler characteristic, antipodal trace and full-group invariant dimension; exact signed fixed-face Lefschetz sums across all 48 automorphisms yield the 10-class character. Finite exhaustive computation is a complete proof here because the graph has only twelve vertices, not an experiment extrapolated to infinite graphs.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical cuboctahedron, which is also the first nontrivial three-dimensional cube line graph. Its 2-independence complex is a natural higher-independence invariant motivated by current 2026 graph-complex work. Determining its integral homotopy type by a perfect finite acyclic-Morse certificate is not a textbook deduction or restatement of the different two-matching complex on the same vertices. The complete rational 48-automorphism character, including two globally invariant classes and the nontrivial 21/11 antipodal split, gives new structural information beyond Betti numbers. No unsupported infinite-family or downstream result is asserted.
